suggestedGoal: Add a dark mode toggle that remembers my choice

script.text: Splitting the goal into work orders

orders.name: Pip
orders.title: Map where colors are defined
orders.acceptance: A list of every hard-coded color, grouped into tokens
orders.prompt: Find every hard-coded color and propose CSS variables.
orders.summary: Found 14 hard-coded colors in 3 files and grouped them into 6 tokens.

orders.name: Rivet
orders.title: Add theme tokens and the toggle button
orders.acceptance: A toggle switches light and dark; all colors come from variables
orders.prompt: Move colors to CSS variables and add a light/dark toggle.
orders.summary: Colors now come from CSS variables and a toggle switches light and dark.

approval.title: Run: npm run build
approval.detail: npm run build (in the todo-app folder)

orders.name: Nova
orders.title: Remember the theme choice
orders.acceptance: Reloading the page keeps the chosen theme
orders.prompt: Persist the chosen theme and restore it on load.
orders.summary: The chosen theme is saved and restored on load.

check.name: persist.test.js
fixOutput: > the load path reads 'theme' but the save path wrote 'theme '

orders.name: Dot
orders.title: Make the settings page respect the theme
orders.acceptance: The settings page uses the same variables and looks right in both themes
orders.prompt: Update the settings page to use theme variables.
orders.summary: The settings page uses theme variables and reads correctly in both themes.

orders.name: Tally
orders.title: Run the full suite and review the result
orders.acceptance: All tests pass and no hard-coded colors remain
orders.prompt: Run the test suite and search for leftover hard-coded colors.
orders.summary: All 24 tests pass and no hard-coded colors are left.
